meta.summary: Yahoo! JAPAN: ad slots, app and homepage banners, promo strips, plus thumbnail, recommended-article and corporate-box controls
meta.notes:
Checked LIVE on 2026-11-13: rendered DOM of www.yahoo.co.jp (desktop UA) and m.yahoo.co.jp (iPhone UA 390x844, to which the phone is redirected), logged out, captured with headless Chrome; counts were taken on the saved DOM. Fixtures real.html (phone) and desktop-real.html are structural captures with text stripped. The desktop page uses stable, readable element ids (`Perorin`, `TopLink`, `Topics`, `Stream`, `realtime`, `biz`, `csr`, `info`, `TPR`, `TBP`, `STREAMAD1` to `STREAMAD13`); the phone page uses `log-*` ids plus hashed CSS-module classes, which are not used.

LIVE counts: desktop `#Perorin` 1, `#TopLink` 1, `#StatusTakarabako` 1, `#TPR`/`#TBP`/`#TCBX`/`#TBPCB`/`#GDN`/`#OVERLAY`/`#overlayAdsContainer` 1 each, `[id^="STREAMAD"]` 13, `[id^="ssp_ydn_"]` 2, `#Stream` 1 (50 pictures), `#Topics img` 1, `#realtime` 1, `#biz`/`#csr`/`#info` 1 each. Phone `#log-rsab` 1 (the Use the app banner), `#ad-fixed-banner`, `#ad-popup-feedback`, `#opening-screen-ad`, `#prem-ad`, `#stb2Ad1` 1 each, `[id^="ssp_ydn_"]` 3, `#log-kisekae-balloon`, `#log-customBalloon`, `#log-homenotice` 1 each, `#log-stream img` 11.

The original generic cookie, ad and app rules matched nothing on this site and are kept; two Yahoo! JAPAN rules were added to the ads and app-banners options. Most slot containers were empty in the capture (the ads are served late), so this proves the containers exist, not that an ad filled them. Japanese-only site: no English labels are relied on. NOT verified: Yahoo! JAPAN News (news.yahoo.co.jp), Shopping, Auctions, Travel and other sub-sites matched by the same domain; the logged-in state.
